content.description: GGMC is an exclusive community for those who want maximum diversified exposure across crypto, web3, and beyond. Bringing true decentralisation and gamification to cryptocurrency mining. Every gopher will have one of the seven professions below, each with their own perks deeply intertwined with GGMC’s utility.The profession of your gopher depends on the assets it has. We are the first mining club to mine multiple coins. We will mine Bitcoin, Kadena, Litecoin and Doge. Going forward we can add more coins to the roster based on community preference.
